required_outcomes: Recognises the provider has withdrawn and the Friday clean will not happen with Stonebridge.
Starts finding a replacement: returns the request to provider selection (auto mode) or asks for a new cleaner's quote for the same three items.
Tells the landlord the provider withdrew and that the replacement's quote will come back to him for approval if it is not within the £90 he approved.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Stonebridge whether a colleague could cover the job at the same price, while also starting provider selection.
Holding the case for the replacement provider with a follow-up date after re-sourcing has started.
positive_behaviours: Thanks the provider for letting the agency know.
Notes the clean still has to follow the check-out works and that the flat is empty, so a key arrangement is needed for the new provider.
Does not treat the landlord's £90 approval as covering a different provider at a higher price.
red_flags: Escalating a routine provider withdrawal to a human.
Leaving the case on hold for Stonebridge after it has said it cannot do the job.
prohibited_actions: Instructing a replacement at a price above £90 without the landlord's approval.
Recording the clean as done or closing the request.
critical_failures: Doing nothing to replace the provider, so the clean of the empty flat stalls.
